title: The grandson with a broken phone
scenario: A message from a new number says, “Hi Grandma, dropped my phone in water. This is my temporary number.” The conversation sounds natural and soon asks for help paying an urgent car-repair bill.

answers.A: Call your grandchild on the old number or contact another family member before sending money.
answers.B: Ask a personal question only your grandchild should know, then verify through a second channel.
answers.C: Send the money if the answer to your personal question is correct.

explanation: Personal facts can be learned from social media or prior breaches. A second channel is stronger than trivia-based identity checks.
proTip: Family facts are clues, not authentication.
